problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 1, упр. 1, с. 3. По семейному древу дополни предложения: кто кем приходится в семьях Клэр и Пола.
steps: 1) Семья Клэр: Jay — Clare's brother; Steve — Jay and Clare's dad; Jay — Elaine and Steve's son; бабушка и дедушка — Clare and Jay's grandparents; Elaine — Clare and Jay's mum.

2) Семья Пола: Oliver — Paul's brother; бабушка — Paul's grandma; дедушка — Paul's grandpa; родители — Paul, Celia and Oliver's parents; бабушка и дедушка — Paul and Oliver's grandparents; Celia — Paul's sister.
problems.answer: Clare's brother; Jay and Clare's dad; Elaine and Steve's son; Clare and Jay's grandparents; Paul's brother; Paul's grandma; Paul's grandpa; Paul, Celia and Oliver's parents

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 2, упр. 1, с. 4. Запиши глаголы в форме Past Simple в нужную колонку по чтению окончания -ed и неправильные глаголы отдельно.
steps: [t]: worked, helped, watched, cooked, walked.
[d]: travelled, played, stayed, listened, cleaned.
[id]: visited, wanted, painted, skated.
Неправильные: went, saw, had, was/were, took, swam, ate.
problems.answer: [t] worked, helped, watched; [d] travelled, played, stayed; [id] visited, wanted, painted; irregular: went, saw, had, was, took

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 3, упр. 1, с. 5. 1) Где путешествовали дети — дополни предложения глаголами в Past Simple. 2) Прослушай запись и проверь.
steps: 1) went; was; went; wore; played; was.
2) Смысл текста: в прошлом году семья ездила в Ирландию, её называют Изумрудным островом; приём был тёплым, дети носили зелёное, играли в ирландские игры, погода была дождливой.
problems.answer: went, was, went, wore, played, was

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 3, упр. 2, с. 6. Дополни вопросы и опроси одноклассников о летних каникулах, затем запиши результаты.
steps: Вопросы: Did you travel in summer? When did you travel? Where did you go? Who did you go with? What did you do there?
Пример результатов: Two pupils travelled in summer, two didn't. One pupil travelled in June and the other in July. One went to the seaside, the other to the country. Both went with their parents.
problems.answer: Вопросы в Past Simple (Did you…? When / Where / Who with / What did you…?) и 4–5 предложений о результатах опроса

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 3, упр. 3, с. 7. 1) По списку планов Пола расскажи, что он сделал, а что нет. 2) Напиши о своей прошлой неделе.
steps: 1) Paul bought a present for his mum on Wednesday. He didn't watch a new video on Thursday. He went to Tom's birthday party on Friday. He didn't clean his room on Saturday. He played football on Sunday.
2) Пример: Last week I played basketball, walked with my friends, went to the cinema and helped my grandmother. I didn't read a new book and didn't visit the museum because I had no time.
problems.answer: Утверждения и отрицания в Past Simple по списку Пола + 4–5 предложений о себе

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 4, упр. 1, с. 8. У Клэр поездка во Францию: напиши вопросы, которые ты хочешь задать, и письмо.
steps: Вопросы: When will you go? Will you travel by train? Where will you stay? What cities will you visit? What will you do there?

Пример письма: Dear Clare, I've heard you'll go to France soon. When will you go? Will you travel by plane? What cities will you visit? I hope you'll have a great time. Write to me about your trip. Love, Masha.
problems.answer: 5 вопросов с will (when, how, where stay, what cities, what do) + короткое письмо Клэр

steps: Подбираем реплику, подходящую по ситуации знакомства.

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 5, упр. 2, с. 10. 1) Прочитай письмо Лауры и оформи адрес по-английски. 2) Напиши Лауре письмо о себе.
steps: 1) Адрес по-английски пишется от меньшего к большему: flat 8, 25 Moskovskaya Street, Saint Petersburg, Russia, 886625.

2) Пример: flat 8, 20 Lenina Street, Moscow, Russia. 25 May. Dear Laura, Hi! My name's Nastya. I'm 12. My birthday is on May 30. I live in Moscow with my parents and my brother. I like reading and swimming. I want to be your pen friend. Please write back. Best wishes, Nastya.
problems.answer: Адрес: flat, street, city, country, postcode; письмо о себе — имя, возраст, день рождения, семья, увлечения

problems.answer: doing, reads, takes, watching, goes — Дэниел слушает музыку, читает, фотографирует, смотрит видео, плавает

steps: Верные — 1, 2, 3, 5; неверные — 4, 6, 7.

problems.condition: Unit 1, Test yourself, задание II, с. 15. Прочитай тексты о школах Великобритании и США и заполни таблицу.
steps: Школьный год: в Британии — с сентября по июль (3 триместра), в США — с сентября по июнь (2 семестра).
Каникулы: в Британии — на Рождество, Пасху и летом 6 недель; в США — лето около 10 недель.
Форма: в Британии обязательна в большинстве школ, в США — обычно нет. Оценки: буквы A–F в США, в Британии — баллы и уровни.
problems.answer: Таблица: длительность года, каникулы, форма, оценки — по данным двух текстов

problems.condition: Unit 2, Lesson 1, упр. 2, с. 19. 1) Почему дети должны следовать правилам — соотнеси. 2) Напиши письмо в газету о правилах.

problems.answer: 5 предложений с have to / don't have to о предметах, форме, расписании, домашней работе

problems.answer: Ответы-сравнения: … either (в отрицании), … too (в утверждении), But I … (когда не совпадает)

problems.condition: Unit 6, Consolidation, упр. 6, с. 85. По ежедневнику Пола скажи, что он делал на этой неделе, когда и в какое время.
steps: Paul has been to the sports centre this week. He went there on Sunday. He was playing tennis with Bob from 5 to 6.
Paul has visited his grandma this week. He visited her on Tuesday. He was helping her in the garden from 4 to 5.
Paul has been to the cinema this week. He went there on Friday. He was watching a film from 6 to 8.
problems.answer: Тройки: has been / has visited (this week) → went / visited (день) → was doing (время)

problems.condition: Unit 6, Consolidation, упр. 7, с. 86. Найди 7 ошибок в диалоге и исправь.
steps: Have you been to the shop yet? — Yes, I have. What did you buy? — I bought bread and milk. Did you see Tom there? — No, I didn't. He was working at that time. Have you already cooked dinner? — Not yet.
problems.answer: Исправления: been to, Yes, I have; did you buy; bought; didn't; was working; already

chapters.title: Unit 6. We've had a nice trip to England. Test yourself.

steps: T, F, T, T, F, F.
problems.answer: T F T T F F

problems.condition: Unit 6, Test yourself, задание II, с. 87. Конкурс «Моя худшая поездка»: 1) соотнеси абзацы; 2) True / False; 3) выпиши формы времён.
steps: 1) A, C, B, E, D.
2) T, F, F, T, T.
3) Past Simple: opened. Past Progressive: were driving. Present Perfect: have never had.
problems.answer: 1) A C B E D; 2) T F F T T; 3) opened (PS), were driving (PProg), have never had (PP)

problems.condition: Unit 6, Test yourself, задание III, с. 88. 1) Раскрой скобки. 2) Рассказ Пола о вчерашнем дне — вставь предлоги и союзы.
steps: 1) was; was riding; have been; watched; played; were playing; have never seen; saw.
2) to; when; from; to; for; while; of; during; at; at.
problems.answer: 1) was, was riding, have been, watched, played, were playing, have never seen, saw; 2) to, when, from, to, for, while, of, during, at, at

problems.condition: Unit 6, Test yourself, задание IV, с. 89. Оцени, что было самым трудным и самым интересным в разделе 6.
steps: Пример: Doing grammar exercises was the most difficult. Listening to children's conversations about travelling was the most interesting. Now I can talk about my trips using three past tenses.
problems.answer: Самооценка: самое трудное, самое интересное, что умею

problems.condition: Unit 7, Lesson 1, упр. 1, с. 91. Прочитай диалоги и определи, где речь о настоящем (Pr), а где о будущем (F).
steps: Диалог 1: A — Pr (собираемся сейчас), B — F (поедем в июне). Диалог 2: A — F, B — Pr. Диалог 3: A — Pr, B — F. Ориентир — указатели времени (now, next week, in June) и форма глагола.
problems.answer: Pr — действия сейчас (Present Progressive без будущих указателей); F — планы с be going to / Present Progressive + время в будущем

problems.condition: Unit 7, Lesson 1, упр. 2, с. 92. 1) По таблице дополни диалоги о планах друзей. 2) Расскажи о планах на выходные. 3) Напиши другу о планах на неделю.
steps: 1) On Tuesday Roy and I are going to the cinema after school. — We're sorry, we can't: Roy and I are going to visit our grandma and grandpa. — On Thursday we're playing football.
2) On Saturday morning I'm going to my grandparents. After school I'm taking a walk with my dog. On Saturday evening I'm watching a film. On Sunday I'm playing tennis.

3) Next week will be very busy. On Monday I'm taking part in a swimming competition. On Tuesday and Wednesday after school I'm going to the art club. On Friday we're visiting the museum with the class.
problems.answer: Планы в Present Progressive с указанием дня: On Monday I'm taking part in…

problems.condition: Unit 7, Lesson 2, упр. 1, с. 93. Составь предложения со словами из рамки (be going to).
steps: He is going to collect leaves. She is going to sew doll's clothes. He is going to learn new magic tricks. She is going to gather apples. They are going to make a bird house.
problems.answer: Предложения He / She / They + is / are going to + действие

problems.condition: Unit 7, Lesson 2, упр. 2, с. 94. Составь вопросы из слов (be going to).
steps: What books is Liz going to read? What films is Liz going to see? Are you going to see the Tower of London? Are you going to travel by train? Where are they going to stay? When is he going to come back?
problems.answer: Общие и специальные вопросы с be going to

problems.condition: Unit 7, Lesson 3, упр. 1, с. 95. 1) Что семья Дугласов будет делать завтра. 2) Что ты делаешь каждый день и что будешь / не будешь делать завтра.
steps: 1) Clare Douglas will go to school. Mr Douglas will go to work. Clare will play the piano. Clare and her parents will watch TV. Mrs Douglas will cook dinner.
2) Every day: I read a lot. I clean my room. I wash the dishes. Tomorrow: I will study English. I won't play computer games. I will visit my friend.
problems.answer: Future Simple (will / won't) для завтра, Present Simple для every day

problems.condition: Unit 7, Lesson 4, упр. 1, с. 96. Раскрой скобки: will или be going to.
steps: are going to visit; will watch, is going to stay, will read; are not going, will go, will ride, will fly.
problems.answer: are going to visit; will watch, is going to stay, will read; are not going, will go, will ride, will fly

problems.condition: Unit 7, Lesson 4, упр. 2, с. 96. Выбери правильный вариант: Present Progressive (договорённость) или will (решение сейчас).
steps: is leaving; will go; are spending; will go.
problems.answer: is leaving, will go, are spending, will go

problems.condition: Unit 7, Lesson 5, упр. 1, с. 97. Подбери подходящий ответ a / b.
steps: B, A, A, A, A.
problems.answer: B A A A A

problems.condition: Unit 7, Consolidation, упр. 1, с. 98. Распредели действия из диалога Стюарта по трём группам: запланировано и подготовлено, собираются сделать, возможно сделают.
steps: Запланировано (Present Progressive): are leaving on Friday, are staying at a hotel, are flying to Paris.
Собираются (be going to): are going to see the Eiffel Tower, are going to visit the Louvre.
Возможно (will / may): will probably go boating, may buy souvenirs.
problems.answer: Present Progressive — твёрдые планы; be going to — намерения; will / may — предположения

problems.condition: Unit 7, Consolidation, упр. 2, с. 98. Дополни диалог, выбрав варианты 1–11.
steps: A, C, A, B, A, C, B, B, A, B, B.
problems.answer: A C A B A C B B A B B

problems.condition: Unit 7, Consolidation, упр. 3, с. 99. Дополни диалоги подходящими вариантами.
steps: C, B, A.
problems.answer: C B A

problems.condition: Unit 7, Consolidation, упр. 4, с. 99. По планам Тома запиши, как он проведёт неделю в Москве.
steps: We are going to tour Moscow on Tuesday. We will visit the Kremlin on Tuesday. We are going to take rides in Gorky Park on Wednesday. We will go to the Bolshoi Theatre on Thursday. We are going to visit the Tretyakov Gallery on Friday. We will go home on Saturday.
problems.answer: Планы по дням с be going to / will

problems.condition: Unit 7, Consolidation, упр. 5, с. 100. Составь 5 вопросов о мероприятиях с Shall I…?
steps: Shall I buy some food for the dogs? Shall I take an umbrella? Shall I take my swimming costume? Shall I wear a folk costume? Shall I bring my camera?
problems.answer: Shall I buy…? / take…? / wear…? / bring…?

problems.condition: Unit 7, Consolidation, упр. 6, с. 100. Соотнеси реплики и определи, о настоящем (Pr) или будущем (F) идёт речь.
steps: Пары: A — c, B — e, C — d, D — a, E — b.
A — Pr, B — F, C — Pr, D — F, E — Pr; a — Pr, b — F, c — Pr, d — Pr, e — F.
problems.answer: A-c, B-e, C-d, D-a, E-b; Pr/F по указателям времени

problems.condition: Unit 7, Consolidation, упр. 7, с. 100. Построй вопросы и дополни диалог о поездке в Эдинбург.
steps: Where are you going? Are you going to visit the Botanic Gardens? When are you going to visit Edinburgh Castle? Will you go to the Military Tattoo? What are you going to do in the evening? How long are you staying?
problems.answer: Where are you going? / Are you going to visit…? / When are you going to…? / Will you go to…? / How long are you staying?

chapters.title: Unit 7. My favorite holiday. Test yourself.

problems.condition: Unit 7, Test yourself, задание I, с. 101. Два друга о поездке в Россию — прослушай и заполни таблицу, кто что собирается делать.
steps: Sam: go to St Petersburg, visit its famous museums, go to the Russian Museum, go to the ballet, make a film.
Peter: go to Moscow and St Petersburg, see the Kremlin, go to the circus, buy souvenirs.
problems.answer: Sam — Петербург, музеи, Русский музей, балет, фильм; Peter — Москва и Петербург, Кремль, цирк, сувениры

problems.condition: Unit 7, Test yourself, задание II, с. 102. Нэнси и Майкл в гостях у Робина и дедушки — отметь True / False.
steps: True, True, False, True, False, False, True, True.
problems.answer: T T F T F F T T

problems.condition: Unit 7, Test yourself, задание III, с. 103. 1) Диалог — выбери формы глаголов. 2) Телефонный разговор Рика. 3) Мэри и Филип Суон у турагента — выбери варианты.
steps: 1) will buy; am going to give; will watch; will come.
2) will swim and fish; will spend; will go; will play; is taking part; is going. Твёрдые планы: He is taking part in the fishing competition; Mum is going with him.
3) C, A, A, B, B, A, C, B, A, C, B.
problems.answer: 1) will buy, am going to give, will watch, will come; 2) will swim and fish, will spend, will go, will play, is taking part, is going; 3) C A A B B A C B A C B

problems.condition: Unit 7, Test yourself, задание IV, с. 105. Оцени знания, умения и навыки по разделу 7.
steps: Отмечаем: умею говорить о планах (be going to, Present Progressive), о предположениях (will), понимаю тексты и разговоры о будущих каникулах; дописываем номера самых полезных упражнений.
problems.answer: Таблица самооценки раздела 7 + номера упражнений

problems.condition: Unit 8, Lesson 1, упр. 1, с. 106. Соотнеси формы глаголов из учебника (с. 132) с названиями времён.
steps: A, G, B, D, C, F, I, E, G, H.
problems.answer: A G B D C F I E G H

problems.condition: Unit 8, Lesson 1, упр. 2, с. 106. Заполни пропуски в тексте о марафоне глаголами из шапки.
steps: started; competed; have run; is; is; didn't run; has been; run; was; is.
problems.answer: started, competed, have run, is, is, didn't run, has been, run, was, is

problems.condition: Unit 8, Lesson 1, упр. 3, с. 107. 1) Впечатления о поездке в Англию — раскрой скобки. 2) Соотнеси формы с временами.
steps: 1) will not forget; are having; are going to visit; went; enjoy; were watching.
2) Present Simple — enjoy; Past Simple — went; Future Simple — will not forget; Present Progressive — are having; Past Progressive — were watching; be going to — are going to visit.
problems.answer: will not forget (Future), are having (Pres. Progr.), are going to visit, went (Past), enjoy (Pres.), were watching (Past Progr.)

problems.condition: Unit 8, Lesson 2, упр. 1, с. 107. Сколько мест видно с колеса London Eye — заполни таблицу по записи.
steps: Big Ben — 1; Buckingham Palace — 1; bridges — 36; the Thames — 1; parks — 8; St Paul's Cathedral — 1.
problems.answer: Биг-Бен 1, Букингемский дворец 1, мосты 36, Темза 1, парки 8

problems.condition: Unit 8, Lesson 2, упр. 2, с. 108. Дополни пропуски 1–11 в тексте о жителях Лондона.
steps: has lived; 1989; has lived; 33; were; have lived; 32; have lived; 1991; were; 31.
problems.answer: has lived (since 1989 / for 33 years), were, have lived (for 32 / since 1991), were, 31

problems.condition: Unit 8, Lesson 3, упр. 1, с. 108. 1) Догадайся о значении существительных с -er / -or. 2) Соотнеси известных людей с достижениями и заполни предложения.
steps: 1) explorer — исследователь; composer — композитор; actor — актёр; singer — певец; traveller — путешественник.

2) F. Shalyapin was a singer, he sang. Yu. Nikulin was an actor, he played. Yu. Gagarin and V. Tereshkova were cosmonauts, they went into space. A. Pushkin was a poet, he wrote. P. Tchaikovsky was a composer, he composed.
problems.answer: explorer, composer, actor, singer, traveller; Шаляпин — пел, Никулин — играл, Гагарин и Терешкова — летали в космос, Пушкин — писал

problems.condition: Unit 8, Lesson 4, упр. 1, с. 110. Правила скейт-парка в Лондоне — вставь модальные глаголы.
steps: can't; must; can; can't; should; can; can; shouldn't.
problems.answer: can't, must, can, can't, should, can, can, shouldn't

problems.condition: Unit 8, Lesson 5, упр. 1, с. 110. Выделенные глаголы из учебника (с. 144) распредели по временам.
steps: Past Simple: toured, went on, liked, made friends. Present Simple: is, love. Present Progressive: are having. Present Perfect: have seen. Future Simple: will never forget, will come back.
problems.answer: Past — toured, went on, liked, made friends; Present — is, are having, have seen; Future — will never forget, will come back

problems.condition: Unit 8, Lesson 5, упр. 2, с. 110. Ответь на вопросы 1–4, выбрав вариант.
steps: B, C, C, A.
problems.answer: B C C A

problems.condition: Unit 8, Consolidation, упр. 1, с. 111. Поставь глагол write в нужное время и соотнеси с правилом.
steps: write — 1.1 A; wrote — 2.1 E; am writing — 1.2 A; will write — 3.1 B; am going to write — 3.3 D; writing — 3.2 B; was writing — 2.2; have written — 1.3.
problems.answer: write, wrote, am writing, will write, am going to write, writing, was writing, have written

problems.condition: Unit 8, Consolidation, упр. 2, с. 112. Письмо Клэр — выбери правильное время.
steps: arrived; have stayed; to; have already seen; went; was; are travelling; are arriving; will stay.
problems.answer: arrived, have stayed, to, have already seen, went, was, are travelling, are arriving, will stay

problems.condition: Unit 8, Consolidation, упр. 3, с. 112. Диалог — выбери форму глагола.
steps: did; did you do; went; do; have learnt.
problems.answer: did, did you do, went, do, have learnt

problems.condition: Unit 8, Consolidation, упр. 4, с. 113. Выпиши полные формы сокращённых глаголов с открытки.
steps: will; will not; is; have; am; have; have; has; are.
problems.answer: will, will not, is, have, am, have, have, has, are

problems.condition: Unit 8, Consolidation, упр. 5, с. 113. Ответь на вопросы о себе.
steps: I like playing computer games. I don't play football every day. I am doing my homework now. Yesterday I walked my dog. I have already read this book. I will go to the cinema on Sunday. I'm going to visit my grandma next week.
problems.answer: Ответы полными предложениями в разных временах

problems.condition: Unit 8, Consolidation, упр. 6, с. 114. Ответь на вопросы, используя since или for.
steps: I have studied at my school for 5 years. I have lived in this city since I was born. I have known my best friend for 6 years. I have learnt English since the second form. I have had my pet for two years.
problems.answer: for + период (5 years, 6 years), since + момент (I was born, the second form)

steps: A, F, E, D, H, I, C.
problems.answer: A F E D H I C

problems.condition: Unit 8, Test yourself, задание II, с. 115. События в городе: 1) дополни предложения буквами; 2) краткие ответы на вопросы 1–10.

2) On the 15th of September; the animal show; Edinburgh; on King Street; on Saturday; at 3 p.m.; at the Sports Centre; at the Town Hall; «Alice in Wonderland»; £5.

problems.condition: Unit 8, Test yourself, задание III, с. 117. 1) Рассказ Меган — формы глаголов. 2.1) Соотнеси начала и концы предложений. 2.2) Выпиши формы по временам.

2.2) A — a, B — b, C — f, D — d, E — c, F — h, G — e, H — g.

problems.condition: Unit 8, Test yourself, задание IV, с. 118. Оцени свои результаты по критериям.
steps: Отмечаем: могу читать и понимать рассказы о путешествиях и экскурсиях; понимаю разговоры о впечатлениях; умею рассказывать о поездке в разных временах; умею писать письмо о событии.
problems.answer: Самооценка по критериям раздела 8

problems.condition: All about me, упр. 1, с. 120. Нарисуй своё семейное древо и подпиши по-английски.
steps: Слова: a family — семья, a mother — мама, a father — папа, a sister — сестра, a brother — брат, a grandmother — бабушка, a grandfather — дедушка, an aunt — тётя, an uncle — дядя, a cousin — двоюродный брат / сестра.
Пример: My name is Anna. My mother is Olga, my father is Igor. I have a brother, Misha. My grandparents are Nina and Pyotr.
problems.answer: Семейное древо с подписями (mother, father, sister, brother, grandparents…) и 3–4 предложения о семье

problems.condition: All about me, упр. 2, с. 121. Дополни предложения о том, чем семья любит заниматься вместе.
steps: My family and I really enjoy travelling. In the evenings we often watch TV. Sometimes we go hiking. At weekends we visit our relatives. In summer we go to the seaside. I like it when we play board games together.
problems.answer: 5–6 предложений о совместных занятиях семьи в Present Simple

problems.condition: All about me, упр. 3, с. 121. Нарисуй расписание и опиши свои занятия в 5 классе.
steps: Пример: Monday 8:30–9:15 Russian, 9:30–10:15 Science, 10:30–11:15 Maths; Tuesday — Geography, English, PE; Wednesday — Art, History, Maths…
I have 6 lessons every day. My favourite subject is English. I have it three times a week. After school I go to the swimming pool.
problems.answer: Таблица расписания по дням + 3–4 предложения о предметах и любимом уроке

problems.condition: All about me, упр. 4, с. 122. Дополни предложения о правилах в своей школе.
steps: At my school we have to follow these rules: we must wear a uniform and keep quiet in class, we mustn't use mobile phones or run in the corridors. We should be polite to teachers and help each other. I think these rules are fair.
problems.answer: Правила с must / mustn't / have to / should + своё мнение

problems.condition: All about me, упр. 5, с. 122. Дополни предложения о домашних обязанностях в семье.
steps: In my family there are the following chores: I have to clean my room, make my bed and water the flowers. But I don't mind. My brother has to take the dog for a walk. My mum cooks and my dad does the shopping. I don't like washing up, but I do it.
problems.answer: 4–5 предложений с have to о своих обязанностях и обязанностях родных

problems.condition: All about me, упр. 6, с. 122. Дополни предложения о том, что ты сделал и чему научился.
steps: I have learnt to do magic tricks. It is interesting to sew soft toys. I've helped my mother to do the shopping and was glad when she thanked me. I have collected old books for the school library.
problems.answer: Предложения в Present Perfect: I have learnt / helped / collected…

problems.condition: All about me, упр. 7, с. 123. Дополни предложения о ежедневных занятиях.
steps: Every day I help my parents about the house. In the evenings my family and I watch TV. I have lunch at school every day. On Tuesdays I go to the swimming pool. At weekends I meet my friends.
problems.answer: 5 предложений в Present Simple с указателями every day, in the evenings, on Tuesdays, at weekends

problems.condition: All about me, упр. 8, с. 123. Дополни предложения о любимых праздниках в семье.
steps: My mum's favourite holiday is Easter because we have a big party, colour eggs and cook traditional food. My dad's number one holiday is Victory Day because he loves the parade. My favourite holiday is New Year because we decorate the tree and get presents.
problems.answer: Любимые праздники мамы, папы и свой с объяснением because…

problems.condition: All about me, упр. 9, с. 124. Дополни предложения о лучшем празднике, который помнишь.
steps: The best holiday that I remember was New Year. We celebrated it in 2020. I was 8 years old. My parents cooked traditional food, we decorated the tree and watched fireworks at midnight. I got a bike as a present. It was fantastic.
problems.answer: Рассказ в Past Simple: какой праздник, когда, сколько лет, что делали, что понравилось

problems.condition: All about me, упр. 10, с. 125. Заполни дневник и расскажи о своей неделе.
steps: Пример таблицы: Monday 8:30–13:15 school — studied; Tuesday 14:30–15:30 swimming pool — swam; Wednesday 16:00 music school — played the piano; Thursday — helped mum; Friday — went to the cinema; Saturday — visited grandma; Sunday — played football.
Текст: On Monday I was at school from 8:30 to 13:15. On Tuesday I swam in the pool…
problems.answer: Дневник по дням (день, время, место, что делал) + рассказ в Past Simple

problems.condition: All about me, упр. 11, с. 126. Дополни предложения о том, чему научился за год.
steps: The best thing I've learnt this year is how to clean up the neighbourhood. I couldn't rake the leaves but now I can. I think it's important to help people around. I have also learnt to speak English better.
problems.answer: 3–4 предложения: I've learnt…, I couldn't… but now I can…, I think it's important…

problems.condition: All about me, упр. 12, с. 126. Дополни предложения о своей лучшей экскурсии.
steps: This school year we had a lot of interesting excursions. We went to the Darwin Museum in autumn. It was interesting because we took part in a quiz and saw dinosaur skeletons. I liked it best of all.
problems.answer: Рассказ в Past Simple: куда, когда, почему интересно

problems.condition: All about me, упр. 13, с. 126. Дополни предложения о планах на лето.
steps: In June we are going to stay at home and plan our holidays. I'm going to go out with my friends and relax in the parks. In July we're going to the seaside. In August I will stay with my grandparents in the country. I think the summer will be great.
problems.answer: Планы по месяцам с be going to / will

problems.condition: All about me, упр. 14, с. 127. Дополни предложения о любимом виде спорта.
steps: I like tennis. It's my favourite sport. I have played it since I was four. I have already played for six years. Soon I will take part in a city competition. I hope I will win.
problems.answer: Текст о спорте: Present Perfect с since / for + план на будущее

problems.condition: All about me, упр. 15, с. 127. Дополни предложения о поездке в столицу.
steps: I have been to Moscow. I was there two years ago. I stayed at my uncle's house. I travelled with my parents. I visited Red Square, the Kremlin and Gorky Park. I liked the metro most of all. I'd like to go there again.
problems.answer: Рассказ: Present Perfect (have been) + Past Simple (was, stayed, visited) + впечатления

problems.condition: All about me, упр. 16, с. 128. Расскажи о своих впечатлениях: фильмы, книги, места, люди.
steps: Films: I have seen the film «Cruella». I saw it in the cinema. It's an exciting film about the villain from «101 Dalmatians».
Books: I have read «Harry Potter». It's the most interesting book I've ever read.
Places: I have been to Kazan. It's a beautiful city with an old Kremlin.
People: I have met a famous footballer. He was very friendly.
problems.answer: 4 мини-текста (фильм, книга, место, человек): I have seen / read / been to / met + оценка
